title.zh: v2.2.2 手机播放器：长按黑胶左右拖动调 BPM（jog）回来了
title.en: v2.2.2 The Phone Player Gets Its Jog Back: Drag the Record to Change the Tempo

highlights.zh: **我上一版把 player2.html 最好玩的交互删掉了，这一版补回来**：按住唱片左右拖动即改速度——左减速、右加速（参考稿的 0.2 BPM/px），唱片同时按拖动量偏移（±1.6 rad 上限），松手后以弹簧回正（`-offset*26`、阻尼 `exp(-5t)`），带惯性的甩动再加最多 ±10 BPM。60–180 BPM 与引擎同一区间。
highlights.en: **The previous release deleted the most enjoyable interaction in player2.html; this one brings it back**: long-press the record and drag left/right to change the tempo (left slower, right faster — the reference's 0.2 BPM per pixel), the disc offsets with the drag (capped at ±1.6 rad), springs back on release (`-offset*26`, damping `exp(-5t)`), and a flick adds up to ±10 BPM. Clamped to the engine's own 60-180 range.

highlights.zh: **手感可测**：jog 的数学全部是纯函数（位移→BPM、角偏移夹取、甩动阈值与上限、弹簧回正），单测 8 条；播放器上另有三条组件用例——拖动 50 px 必须从 122 变 132 BPM、连续拖动必须夹在 60/180、± 按钮也能改并显示当前值。
highlights.en: **The feel is testable**: the jog maths is pure (drag to BPM, offset clamping, flick threshold and cap, spring return) with 8 unit cases, plus 3 component cases on the player — a 50 px drag must take 122 to 132 BPM, a long drag must clamp to 60/180, and the ± buttons must move and display the live value.

highlights.zh: **同时补上参考稿里让 jog「被发现」的两样东西**：唱片下方的拖动提示（左减速 · 右加速），以及显式的 BPM ± 与实时读数。拖动用的是指针捕获（`setPointerCapture`），画布保留 `touch-pan-y`，所以纵向滚页面不会被 jog 吃掉。
highlights.en: **Also restored the two things that make the jog discoverable**: the drag hint under the record (left slower · right faster) and explicit ± buttons with a live BPM readout. The drag uses pointer capture, and the canvas keeps `touch-pan-y`, so vertical page scrolling is not swallowed by the jog.
